**Estate:** 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint. ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots.

**Certification:** Organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.

**Sales:** Export 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan. Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

**Failures:** 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; batch sold in bulk, €11,000 loss. Fixed: pre-harvest calibration, second probe. 2023: 900 mislabelled bottles recalled. Fixed: two signatures on proofs.

**Rules:** No irrigation on western plots (2021 trial cut acidity). Harvest dates from three mornings of sugar/acidity, not calendar. Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Open:** Lighter bottles (2025 proposal; importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison). Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30% in five years.
